title: 图标核心
description: minerva-design/icons/core：不依赖框架的图标集。包括 SVG 字符串、Canvas2D 绘制、GPU 画布、自定义图标、全局默认渲染器，以及 GPU 后端背后的几何处理流程。

intro.title: 不依赖框架
intro.text: 导入核心模块没有副作用，在真正绘制之前不会访问任何浏览器 API，因此可用于服务端代码、Worker、任何框架和普通脚本。图标就是普通对象：{ name, paths, category, tags }。
intro.frameworks: React、Vue、Angular、Web Components、React Native（minerva-design/native/icons）和 Taro（minerva-design/taro/icons）组件都是这个核心之上的薄封装；其他框架可以使用 toSvg 和 createIconCanvas。

IconDefinition.description: An icon: SVG path data on a 24×24 grid, always stroked (never filled) with round caps and joins. The built-in icons and `defineIcon` both produce it.

props.name: name
props.description: Unique kebab-case name, e.g. `arrow-up`

props.name: paths
props.description: SVG path `d` strings (M L H V C S Q T A Z, absolute or relative) on the 24×24 grid

props.name: colors
props.description: Stroke color of each path, parallel to `paths`; `undefined` keeps the drawing color (`color` option, `currentColor` by default). Colors apply to strokes only.

props.name: category
props.description: Group of the icon, e.g. `arrows` (built-in icons always have one)

props.name: tags
props.description: Search words besides the name

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height (a number is in pixels)

props.name: color
props.description: Stroke color

props.name: strokeWidth
props.description: Stroke width on the 24×24 grid

props.name: title
props.description: Accessible name: adds `role="img"` and a `<title>`; without it the SVG is `aria-hidden`

props.name: className
props.description: `class` attribute

props.name: attributes
props.description: Extra attributes, escaped (e.g. `{ "data-icon": "x" }`)

props.name: x
props.description: Left edge in the context's current units

props.name: y
props.description: Top edge in the context's current units

props.name: items
props.description: Icons to draw, in painting order (later ones on top)

props.name: renderer
props.description: Backend preference

props.name: width
props.description: Fixed width in CSS pixels; by default the container's width

props.name: height
props.description: Fixed height in CSS pixels; by default the container's height

props.name: pixelRatio
props.description: Device pixel ratio

props.name: onRendererChange
props.description: Called with the backend once it started, and again after a fallback

IconCanvasController.description: A canvas drawing many icons in one GPU draw (or Canvas2D)

props.name: renderer
props.description: The backend drawing (null until it started)

props.name: canvas
props.description: The `<canvas>` element inside the container

props.name: setItems
props.description: Replaces the icons; drawn on the next animation frame

props.name: setOptions
props.description: Updates options; a new `renderer` restarts the backend

props.name: render
props.description: Draws now (instead of the next animation frame)

props.name: ready
props.description: Resolves once the backend started and the current items are drawn

props.name: destroy
props.description: Removes the canvas and releases the GPU resources

props.name: icon
props.description: The icon to draw

props.name: renderer
props.description: Backend preference

props.name: pixelRatio
props.description: Device pixel ratio

props.name: onRendererChange
props.description: Called with the backend once it drew, and again after a fallback

IconSurface.description: A single icon on its own `<canvas>`, drawn by a backend shared by the page

props.name: renderer
props.description: The backend that drew it (null until the first frame)

props.name: update
props.description: Replaces the options; redrawn on the next animation frame

props.name: destroy
props.description: Stops drawing (the canvas is left in place)

props.name: strokeWidth
props.description: Stroke width on the 24×24 grid

props.name: tolerance
props.description: Largest distance between the mesh and the exact outline, in grid units

IconPolyline.description: A flattened subpath: `points` is `[x0, y0, x1, y1, …]`

props.name: closed
props.description: Ends with Z (the last point joins the first)

examples.title: Canvas2D
examples.description: drawIcon 在任意 2D 上下文（DOM 画布、OffscreenCanvas、小程序画布）上用原生描边绘制图标，并沿用上下文的变换。

examples.title: 图标画布控制器
examples.description: createIconCanvas 即 IconCanvas 底层的控制器：向任意元素追加一块画布，选择后端，跟随渲染器栏，在 setItems 时重绘，并在 destroy 时释放 GPU 上下文。

examples.title: GPU 几何
examples.description: GPU 后端实际绘制的内容：tessellateIcon 将描边转换为三角形（四边形、圆形连接和线帽），所用曲线由 flattenIconPath 在容差范围内展平。圆点：展平后的中心线。

examples.title: SVG 字符串
examples.description: toSvg 返回一个独立的 、CSS 背景和网站图标（favicon）；toSvgBase64DataUri 生成 base64 编码的 URI，适用于不接受百分号编码 SVG 的图片宿主（小程序）。

data.geometryStats: {{triangles}} 个三角形，{{points}} 个中心线点

IconDefinition.name: 唯一的 kebab-case 名称，如 arrow-up
IconDefinition.paths: 基于 24×24 网格的 SVG 路径 d 字符串（M L H V C S Q T A Z，绝对或相对坐标）
IconDefinition.colors: 与 paths 一一对应的每条路径描边颜色（undefined 表示沿用绘制颜色）
IconDefinition.category: 图标所属分组，如 arrows（内置图标都有分组）
IconDefinition.tags: 名称之外的搜索关键词

IconSvgOptions.size: 宽度和高度（数字表示像素）
IconSvgOptions.strokeWidth: 基于 24×24 网格的描边宽度
IconSvgOptions.title: 无障碍名称：添加 role="img" 和 <title>；未设置时 SVG 为 aria-hidden
IconSvgOptions.attributes: 额外的属性，会被转义（如 { "data-icon": "x" }）

DrawIconOptions.x: 左边缘，使用上下文当前的单位
DrawIconOptions.y: 上边缘，使用上下文当前的单位

IconCanvasOptions.items: 要绘制的图标，按绘制顺序排列（后面的在上层）
IconCanvasOptions.width: 固定宽度，以 CSS 像素为单位；默认为容器宽度
IconCanvasOptions.height: 固定高度，以 CSS 像素为单位；默认为容器高度
IconCanvasOptions.onRendererChange: 后端启动后以其为参数调用，回退后会再次调用

IconCanvasController.renderer: 正在绘制的后端（启动前为 null）
IconCanvasController.setItems: 替换图标；在下一个动画帧绘制
IconCanvasController.setOptions: 更新选项；更换 renderer 会重启后端
IconCanvasController.render: 立即绘制（而不是等到下一个动画帧）
IconCanvasController.ready: 后端启动且当前 items 绘制完成后 resolve
IconCanvasController.destroy: 移除画布并释放 GPU 资源

IconSurfaceOptions.onRendererChange: 后端完成绘制后以其为参数调用，回退后会再次调用

IconSurface.renderer: 绘制它的后端（第一帧之前为 null）
IconSurface.update: 替换选项；在下一个动画帧重绘
IconSurface.destroy: 停止绘制（画布保留在原处）

IconMeshOptions.strokeWidth: 基于 24×24 网格的描边宽度
IconMeshOptions.tolerance: 三角网格与精确轮廓之间的最大距离，以 24×24 网格单位计

IconPolyline.points: 点坐标，形如 [x0, y0, x1, y1, …]
IconPolyline.closed: 以 Z 结尾（最后一个点与第一个点相连）
